strategy.summary: On official ROM 5.00, clear the right-ramp drops, qualify Wheel of Fortune Multiball and a Bonus Wheel Mode, start the Bonus Wheel Mode at the scoop, then return there for Multiball and complete the Jackpot sequence.

quickInfo.name: Right-ramp drops
quickInfo.summary: Clear all three inline drops to open the right ramp and qualify Free Spin, Big Money, and Wild Card.

quickInfo.name: Wheel of Fortune Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell MULTIBALL at the nine green targets, then shoot the lit scoop for three-ball play and a four-Jackpot sequence.

quickInfo.name: Bonus Wheel Modes
quickInfo.summary: Collect the five BONUS shots, then shoot the scoop for one random 30-second mode that can start with multiball.

quickInfo.name: Ramp Multipliers
quickInfo.summary: One outer ramp doubles the next shot, while a left-ramp and right-ramp combo makes the next shot worth 4x.

quickInfo.name: Trip Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Solve a Prize Puzzle or collect a contestant's stored Trip to start its four-shot Jackpot sequence.

quickInfo.name: Official ROM 5.00
quickInfo.summary: Trip Jackpot values persist until a power cycle; do not assume a carried value belongs to the current player.

steps.text: Use a controlled plunge to test the Toss-Up loop and the pop-bumper exit.
Hit the three inline drops until the right ramp is open.
modeNotes: Inline Awards: The first drop lights two Free Spin lanes. The second lights Big Money. The third lights Wild Card.
Free Spin: A lit split outlane earns an autoplunge. Unused lit lanes persist between balls.
Wild Card: The lit lower-left lane scores the built bumper value and a code-dependent award.

steps.text: Hit green MULTIBALL targets until the scoop lights for Wheel of Fortune Multiball.
modeNotes: MULTIBALL Letters: On the first qualification, any of the nine green targets adds a letter.
Later qualifications can require each target once, each target twice, or one specific lit target at a time.
Extra target hits after qualification add 7,500 to the base Jackpot.

steps.text: Collect BONUS at the left loop, left ramp, center ramp, right ramp, and right orbit.
modeNotes: Bonus Wheel Mode: Five BONUS letters qualify one random mode at the scoop. Each mode lasts 30 seconds.
A mode cannot start during multiball. A qualified mode and Wheel of Fortune Multiball can start together at the scoop.
Trip Multiball overrides a qualified Bonus Wheel Mode when the same scoop shot would start both.

steps.text: Shoot the scoop when both Wheel of Fortune Multiball and a Bonus Wheel Mode are ready.
During Wheel of Fortune Multiball, collect the four lit Jackpots in sequence.
modeNotes: Wheel of Fortune Multiball: The scoop starts three-ball play, or four-ball play when Trip Multiball starts with it.
Four of six major shots light for Jackpot, Double Jackpot, Triple Jackpot, and 5x Super Jackpot.
Each Jackpot unlights all shots. Hit any contestant to relight the uncollected Jackpot shots.
After Super Jackpot, hit a contestant to light all six shots for half-Jackpots.
Collect all six half-Jackpots to restart the four-Jackpot sequence.
The multiball ends when one ball remains. Its base Jackpot carries into later Wheel of Fortune Multiballs.

steps.text: Use left-ramp and right-ramp combos before the largest available mode or multiball collect.
modeNotes: Ramp Multiplier: One outer ramp lights 2x for the next shot for approximately five seconds.
Combo both outer ramps in either order to light 4x for the next shot.
The right ramp must be open for its combo shot to register.

steps.text: Prioritize the active mode while extra balls protect the drain.
When one ball remains, rebuild MULTIBALL and BONUS from their current progress.

fallback.title: Free Spins, Super Bumpers, and Super Loops
fallback.when: Use this when the scoop or MULTIBALL standups reject toward a drain.

steps.text: Hit the first inline drop to light two Free Spin outlane rollovers.
Use the right orbit to raise Bumper X and feed the pop bumpers.
Roll through the left inlane to start Super Bumpers.
Shoot the right orbit again before Super Bumpers ends.
Use the right inlane to start Super Loops.
Repeat the left loop within its short timer for rising values.
Take the Free Spin autoplunge if the ball reaches a lit outlane.

alternatives.title: Trip Multiball through a Prize Puzzle
alternatives.when: Use this on tournament code when the current round is even and puzzle progress is close to completion.

steps.text: Hit a lit contestant to reveal a consonant and add its wedge value to that contestant's Prize Bank.
Select the contestant with the most useful Prize Bank before the final letters.
When approximately two-thirds of the puzzle is revealed, shoot the scoop to solve it.
An even tournament round starts three-ball Trip Multiball.
Collect the left ramp, scoop, center ramp, and right ramp for single, double, triple, and 5x Super Jackpot.
A fast combo doubles the next Trip Jackpot.
After Super Jackpot, the base value rises by 100,000 and the sequence relights.

alternatives.title: Ramp Rampage stack
alternatives.when: Use this only when the random Bonus Wheel starts Ramp Rampage and the outer ramps are open.

steps.text: Start Ramp Rampage with Wheel of Fortune Multiball when both are qualified.
Shoot the left ramp for 10x the red wedge.
Shoot the center ramp for 10x the yellow wedge and a new wheel spin.
Shoot the right ramp for 10x the blue wedge.
Each repeat adds another 10x to that ramp for the rest of the 30-second mode.
Use multiball protection to repeat the most reliable ramp.
Clear the right-ramp drops and qualify both main features.
Stack a Bonus Wheel Mode with Wheel of Fortune Multiball.
Complete the four-Jackpot sequence and the six half-Jackpots.
Treat carried Trip Jackpot values as machine state, not earned progress.
Rebuild MULTIBALL and BONUS for the next controlled stack.

techniques.name: Toss-Up skill plunge
techniques.instruction: Use less than full plunge strength so the ball barely circles the back-right Toss-Up post, then shoot the scoop hurry-up.

techniques.name: Free Spin outlane nudge
techniques.instruction: Move the cabinet before the split so the ball enters the lit Free Spin rollover instead of the adjacent unlit rollover.

techniques.name: Outer-ramp 4x combo
techniques.instruction: Shoot either outer ramp, combo the opposite ramp, then use the 4x insert on the next large collect before it expires.

cautions.issue: A weak left-ramp shot can fail to reach its scoring switch.
cautions.response: Confirm the ramp switch before you depend on the 2x or 4x follow-up award.

checkBeforePlay: Test right-ramp switches, scoop, contestants, and Free Spin lanes.

strategy.overview: The nine MULTIBALL targets qualify Wheel of Fortune Multiball at the scoop, while five BONUS shots qualify a Bonus Wheel Mode there. Start the Bonus Wheel Mode first because a mode cannot start once Multiball is running. Clear the right-ramp drops, qualify both features, start them in that order, and complete the ordered Jackpot sequence. Use a left-ramp and right-ramp combo before the largest available collect for 4x.

strategy.summary: On tournament ROM 6.02, qualify Wheel of Fortune Multiball and a Bonus Wheel Mode, start both at the scoop, complete the Jackpot sequence, then meet each mode quota while using retries for unfinished modes.
